title: Slay the Streamer 2
description:
Twitch and YouTube chat votes on the streamer's choices: run start (act variant), Neow and mid-run Ancient blessings, card rewards, and act bosses. Inspired by Tempus's Slay the Streamer for StS1.

Configuration lives in %APPDATA%\SlayTheSpire2\slay_the_streamer_2.json and in the in-game Mods screen once connected.

Setup guide and README: https://github.com/Surfinite/slay-the-streamer-2

Demo: https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2782280062
changeNote: v0.4.5: support for the game's v0.113 Beta (The Fool, Blitz, Dread). v0.4.3 only partly loaded on it and broke at the rewards screen after a fight. If a future game update breaks one of the mod's features, only that feature now switches off and the startup message in chat names it. Dread: when chat changes an act's boss, the act's Dominion changes with it; Custom Mode's Random character button hides while Dread is selected. Blitz: Relic choices leaves its multi-relic chests alone, and merchant card packs follow the Non-combat card rewards setting. Vote overrides register 0.2 seconds after a vote starts instead of 1.5, so you no longer have to keep clicking. Driftwood's explanation text now says what it does: reroll before you click to start chat's vote. Tested against Beta v0.113.1 and the regular branch v0.111.1.
